title: To name the Department of Veterans Affairs temporary lodging facility in Indianapolis, Indiana, as the "Dr. Otis Bowen Veteran House".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the House passed version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 1) This bill designates the  Department of Veterans Affairs temporary lodging facility in Indianapolis, Indiana, as the "Dr. Otis Bowen Veteran House."

summary.headline: A 2016 law names a VA temporary lodging facility in Indianapolis the "Dr. Otis Bowen Veteran House."
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a Department of Veterans Affairs temporary lodging facility in Indianapolis, Indiana. The new name is the "Dr. Otis Bowen Veteran House." It does not change how the facility operates or who can stay there.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 14, 2016.
